subject: Clarify trial grant redemption, invoice token lines, and VAT treatment
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily@lumendata.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T08:12:00Z
Subject: Question: PLG trial grant — will tokens show on invoice?

Hi Priyom,

Quick question — our devs signed up through the PLG flow and received the trial grant today. We noticed an invoice (attached) with a small token charge line and then a separate credit line. Before we escalate to procurement, can you confirm: 1) whether the trial tokens should ever result in a billing charge for us, and 2) whether issuing a VAT number would change how that appears?

If possible, we'd like a short extension on the trial period while we finish a feature test — would that be straightforward to approve from your end?

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Platform Engineer, Lumen Data
Attachment: signup_receipt.pdf (pdf)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@lumendata.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Question: PLG trial grant — will tokens show on invoice?

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and for attaching the invoice. Short answer: trial grants should not result in a net charge for eligible PLG signups. What you are seeing is a gross charge line for usage followed by a promotional credit that offsets it — the net should be zero (or whatever remains after using credits).

A few clarifications so we can resolve this cleanly:
- Can you confirm the Redwood account ID (visible in the footer of the invoice) or your HubSpot company link?
- Please attach the full invoice PDF (looks like you've done that) and the VAT number if you have one — procurement often wants the VAT ID on the invoice for their records.

I can do two things immediately:
1) Loop in our billing team to reissue the invoice so the credit is shown as a single net line (less confusing for procurement).
2) Approve a 14-day extension of the PLG trial grant while you validate. If you prefer a 30-day extension I can propose it but will need a short note from procurement saying that's okay.

I've cc'd Marissa from billing to own the invoice reissuance. I also attached a quick usage export so we can correlate the token rows to the credit.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: trial_usage_report.csv (csv)

On 2028-02-15 at 08:12, Emily Zhao <emily@lumendata.com> wrote:
> Quick question — our devs signed up through the PLG flow and received the trial grant today...

From: procurement@lumendata.com <procurement@lumendata.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Emily Zhao <emily@lumendata.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T11:46:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Invoice attached — VAT and reversal request

Forwarding the invoice from our AP team. We see the token charge (USD 12.40) and then a promotional credit (USD -12.40). AP would prefer the credit to be applied as a single net line (zero) or for you to reissue a corrected invoice showing net zero so it doesn't block our PO reconciliation. Our VAT number is GB999888777.

Also, is it possible to have the trial extended 30 days? We need a bit more time while security completes the last test.

--
Lumen Data AP (accounts-payable@lumendata.com)
Attachment: invoice_20280215.pdf (pdf)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: procurement@lumendata.com <procurement@lumendata.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Emily Zhao <emily@lumendata.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice attached — VAT and reversal request

Thanks for the details — looping in billing.

Hi Lumen AP team,

I reviewed the invoice you attached. What happened here is fairly common with PLG-issued promotional credits: our billing system records raw usage as a positive line item and then issues a promo credit line that offsets it. The net due on this invoice is $0.00. However, I understand AP's need for a single net line for PO reconciliation. We will: 

1) Reissue the invoice with a single net line item showing $0.00 and include your VAT number on the footer (GB999888777).
2) Provide a short explanation note on the reissued PDF that the charge was fully offset by promotional credits issued at signup.

I will send the corrected invoice within 24 hours. Regarding the trial extension: Priyom has suggested 14 days; we can approve 30 days for this account as a one-off due to the procurement delay — I'll mark that as an approved extension and document it on the account. No additional approvals needed.

Please confirm the PO number (if you'll be recording one) so we can include it on the invoice.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference

On 2028-02-15 at 09:03, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Emily — thanks for the note and for attaching the invoice...

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: procurement@lumendata.com <procurement@lumendata.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Emily Zhao <emily@lumendata.com>
Date: 2028-02-16T14:05:00Z
Subject: Final: Reissued invoice + trial extension confirmed

Hi team — quick update: we've reissued invoice INV-20280215-R1 with a single net line of $0.00 and the VAT number you provided (GB999888777). The reissued PDF is available at the HubSpot link below and I'm also attaching it to this thread for your AP.

We also approved a 30-day PLG extension for the account (account ID LD-98765). The extension is active immediately and will appear in your account settings under 'Promotions / Credits.'

Notes for AP: the VAT treatment on the invoice remains the same — VAT is shown where applicable but the promotional credit does not change taxable amount in our system; the reissued invoice includes a short explanatory line to help reconciliation. If you need the invoice without VAT for any reason, please provide the appropriate certificate and we'll advise if we can change treatment.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
Attachment: INV-20280215-R1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — let me know if you need anything else to close the PO.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
